C528 NO. 1251 of 2026
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Mohd. Umar, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. It is contended by the learned counsel for the 
applicant that the application moved under Section 
125 Cr.P.C. by the present applicant is pending for 
consideration in the court of learned Addl. Judge, 
Family Court, Roorkee District Haridwar since 
2020 and the respondent/husband did not turn up 
to join the proceeding.
3. Let the Registry may get report on 
administrative side from the court of Addl. Judge, 
Family Court, Roorkee with regard to case no. 107 
of 2020 which is pending since 2020.
4. Put up this matter on 09.06.2026, as fresh.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
C528 No. 1251 of 2026
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Zakir Ali, learned counsel for the 
applicants.
2. The issue is arising out of matrimonial 
dispute and the Addl. Judge, Family Court, 
Roorkee already passed an ex-parte order on 
11.12.2023 against the respondent/husband but the 
husband did not turn up in the execution 
proceeding.
3. Taking into consideration that the dispute 
appears to be matrimonial one, let efforts may be 
made for their amicable settlement.
4. Issue notice to respondent.
5. Steps to be taken within a week by all modes 
so that on the next date the respondent/husband 
shall remain present in Court.
6. List this matter on 29.06.2026.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
09.06.2026
Parul

 Versus

Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. Mohd. Umar and Mr. Zakir Ali, learned 
counsel for the applicant.
2. On the previous date the notice was issued to the 
respondent and the steps were taken; however, as per 
the office report the respondent refused to accept the 
notice. It reveals that the respondent-husband is 
avoiding the proceedings, which is evident from the 
fact that before the Family Court 125 Cr.P.C. 
proceeding was proceeded exparte.
3. In such view of the matter, there is no any option 
except to issue bailable warrant against the 
respondent.
4. The concerned C.J.M. shall execute the bailable 
warrant against the respondent forthwith.
5. List this matter on 06.07.2026.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
